### About

I am a Research Officer and Software Engineer at the Australian National University. My work connects computational geodynamics, geophysics, numerical modelling, high-performance computing, and open-source research software.

I contribute to the Underworld geodynamics codebase, including core development, user-facing interfaces, testing, debugging, documentation, and training. My research interests include finite-element methods, Stokes-flow benchmarks, subduction-zone dynamics, megathrust seismicity, geophysical data interpretation, and reproducible scientific computing.

## Background

- Research Officer / Software Engineer, Australian National University.
- Senior Research Officer / Software Engineer, Monash University and AuScope.
- PhD in Computational Geodynamics and Geophysics, Monash University and IIT Bombay.
- Bachelor of Science in Mathematics, with Earth & Environmental Science, Indian Institute of Science.

## Current focus

- Underworld and Underworld3 software development.
- Annulus and spherical-shell finite-element benchmarks.
- PETSc, MPI, and HPC workflows for reproducible geodynamics.
- Subduction-zone and megathrust dynamics.
